relations: Flame tongues stretch, curl, split, and re-merge continuously rather than moving as a rigid object.
Early right-leaning tall plumes settle toward the center beneath curling caps, later thinning into hooking tongues above rising columns.
Glowing ember particles drift upward toward the right edge, climbing and dimming as they rise.
The flame base stays near the bottom-center while overall brightness and height fluctuate continuously during active burning.
caption: The video captures a close-up of flickering orange-yellow flames against a solid black background, with small glowing ember particles floating above the fire. The flame body continuously deforms rather than moving as a rigid object, its tongues stretching, curling, splitting and re-merging from frame to frame. Early in the excerpt a tall plume leans to the right, while through the middle the mass settles toward the center beneath a broad horizontal curling cap. As the sequence progresses that cap thins into a smaller hooking tongue above two rising columns, and the overall flame contracts into a lower, narrower cluster near the bottom-center. Several embers drift upward toward the right edge, climbing and dimming as they go. The base of the flame stays roughly at the bottom-center throughout, and the apparent motion is the fire's own flicker rather than any camera movement. Brightness and flame height fluctuate continuously, leaving the burn still active at the final frame.
